:::{#exm-empty-set-zero}
#### A countably additive function with $\measure(\emptyset) = 0$

The counting function $\measure(A) \eqdef \abs{A}$ of @exm-countable-additivity
is countably additive, and:

$$
\ba
\measure(\emptyset)
&= \abs{\emptyset}
&& \text{(definition of } \measure \text{)} \\
&= 0
&& \text{(} \emptyset \text{ has no elements)}
\ea
$$

:::
